name: Kouminkan
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood community center (Kotobuki Kouminkan): a notice about a calligraphy class time change, a first day helping at reception, a usage guide, a notice about a new computer class for seniors, a things-to-bring guide, a reflection on talking respectfully with elderly visitors, a report on teaching a new volunteer the reception checklist, an essay on why usage grew, a December event guide, a column on how the role of community centers has changed, a notice of revised operating rules, a reflection on the meaning of time accumulated at a community center, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elderly-watch network. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
